listen_port.description: The port on which Dropbear listens for incoming SSH connections. Use 22 for standard SSH.

listen_addresses.description: List of IP addresses to bind to. Leave empty to bind to all interfaces.

items.description: A valid IPv4 or IPv6 address (e.g., '127.0.0.1' or '::1').

enable_password_auth.description: Allow password-based login. Disable for key-only authentication (recommended for security).

host_keys.description: List of host key files to load. At least one RSA or Ed25519 key is required.

path.description: Absolute path to the host key file (e.g., '/etc/dropbear/dropbear_rsa_host_key').

type.description: Cryptographic algorithm type of the key.

banner_file.description: Path to a file containing the pre-authentication login banner. Empty to disable.

enable_tcp_forwarding.description: Allow local/remote TCP port forwarding (e.g., for tunneling). Disable if not needed for security.

enable_x11_forwarding.description: Allow X11 forwarding for graphical applications. Enable only if using GUI over SSH.

enable_agent_forwarding.description: Allow SSH agent forwarding (use with caution; enables credential theft risk).

max_auth_tries.description: Maximum authentication attempts per connection before disconnecting the client.

idle_timeout.description: Idle session timeout in seconds. 0 = no timeout (sessions persist).

disable_ipv6.description: If true, disable IPv6 support (forces IPv4 only).

legacy_crypto.description: Enable legacy cryptographic methods for compatibility with old clients. ⚠️ Weakens security.

extra_args.description: Additional command-line arguments for dropbear (e.g., ['-w'] to disallow root login). Avoid duplicating flags set above.

items.description: A single argument (without '--' or '-' prefix; e.g., 'w' for -w).
